payload.title: Blackwell Matrix Multiplication Part 1: Fundamentals
payload.summary: Introduction to GPU architecture fundamentals, Tensor Core evolution from Ampere through Blackwell, and a baseline 4-line matrix multiplication in Mojo achieving 5 TFLOPS on B200.

sections.heading: 1. Series Overview
sections.gist: This series demonstrates how to: - Write a high-performance GPU kernel on Blackwell that matches NVIDIA cuBLAS - Leverage Mojo's features to simplify kernel code

sections.heading: 2. Why Matmul Matters
sections.gist: All large language models (Llama / Qwen / Deepseek / Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini) are built on matrix multiplication (MLP / Attention / MoE).

sections.heading: 3. GPU Architecture from a Hardware Architect's Perspective

sections.heading: 4. Three-Generation Comparison
sections.gist: table columns: Metric, A100, H100, H200, B100, B200

sections.heading: 5. Optimization Paradigm Evolution
sections.gist: Memory operations block compute: load → wait → compute → wait → store.

sections.heading: 6. Four-Line Matmul Implementation
sections.gist: - Create a 2D thread grid covering the entire C matrix - Each thread computes one element of C based on its thread ID
